description: This file defines the DeletePolicyResponse class, a final, immutable Java class representing the response to a delete policy command within an Eclipse Ditto policy management system. It includes factory methods for creating instances from policy IDs, JSON strings, and JSON objects, and implements mechanisms for serialization, equality, and string representation.
